title: Hosea Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Hosea 13: molten images, the morning mist, a king given in anger and the guilt of Samaria.

questions.text: What happened when Ephraim spoke, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: When Ephraim spoke there was trembling; he exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty in Baal he died.

questions.text: Out of what had they made molten images?
questions.explanation: They made themselves molten images of their silver, idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of craftsmen.

questions.text: To what does verse 3 compare them?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says they will be like the morning mist and like the dew that passes away early.

answers.text: The morning mist and the dew

questions.text: What does God say about himself in verse 4?
questions.explanation: He is Yahweh their God from the land of Egypt; they shall acknowledge no god but him, and besides him there is no savior.

answers.text: He has chosen a new people
He will send one more prophet
Besides him there is no savior

questions.text: What happened after they were filled, according to verses 5 and 6?
questions.explanation: God knew them in the wilderness; according to their pasture they were filled, their heart was exalted, and so they forgot him.

answers.text: Their heart was exalted and they forgot God
They offered him thanks in the wilderness
They returned to the land of Egypt
They built him an altar of stone

questions.text: Which animal does God say will lurk by the path?
questions.explanation: God says he is like a lion to them, and that like a leopard he will lurk by the path.

questions.text: What had they said, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: God asks where their king is to save them, and where their judges are, of whom they said, 'Give me a king and princes.'

answers.text: Build us a city of refuge
Give us rain for the harvest
Give me a king and princes

questions.text: How does God say he gave them a king?
questions.explanation: He says he gave them a king in his anger and took him away in his wrath.

questions.text: From what does God say he will ransom them, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: He says he will ransom them from the power of Sheol and redeem them from death.

questions.text: Who will bear her guilt, according to verse 16?
questions.explanation: Samaria will bear her guilt, because she has rebelled against her God.
